title: Implement or remove CodexModel config field
overview:
Users see this field in UI but it has no effect, creating confusion.

**Motivation:** Either implements the feature or removes misleading UI element.

**Technical constraints:**
- Either implement usage in Python automation script or remove from TUI and config

**Signals:** priority: high
problem_statement: Users see this field in UI but it has no effect, creating confusion.
motivation: Either implements the feature or removes misleading UI element.
technical_constraints: Either implement usage in Python automation script or remove from TUI and config
resolution_notes: The CodexModel feature is fully implemented. The Go TUI passes --codex-model to the Python script (runner.go:457), the Python CLI accepts the argument (cli.py:60), and it's used throughout the codebase (worker.py, local_loop.py, pr_flow.py, review_loop.py) to configure the Codex model. The TUI also properly dims the field when disabled by policy via isCodexModelDisabled().
